"Game Title: Ultimate Martial Arts Championship
Genre: 2D Fighting Game / Arcade Fighter
​Core Match Structure:
​Format: Standard 2-round match per fight.
​Match Rules: First fighter to win 2 rounds wins the match. Include a timer per round (99 seconds) and a standard health bar for each character.
​Visual @COMMENT_BODY@ Environment Style:
​Art Style: High-quality, vibrant 2D fighting game aesthetics with fluid character animations and dynamic background visual effects.
​Stages/Locations: Beautiful, cinematic battle arenas (e.g., Cherry Blossom Temple Courtyard, Neon City Rooftop, Sunset Coastal Beach, Ancient Mountain Shrine).
​Roster (10 Unique Characters @COMMENT_BODY@ Fighting Styles):
Generate 10 random character designs, distinct appearance models, visual gear, and specialized move sets corresponding to their specific martial art:
​1. Character 1 (Karate): Traditional gi, focused on powerful linear strikes, decisive high kicks, and rigid defensive blocks.
​2. Character 2 (Kung Fu): Fluid motion, agile acrobatics, circular deflection blocks, and rapid strike combinations.
​3. Character 3 (Wing Chun): Close-range combat specialist utilizing rapid centerline punches (chain punches) and sticky-hand deflects.
​4. Character 4 (Jeet Kune Do): High mobility, non-telegraphed intercepting lead strikes, quick footwork, and aggressive counter-attacks.
​5. Character 5 (Boxing): Duck-and-weave mobility, rapid jab-cross combos, heavy hooks, uppercuts, and high guard defense (no kick maneuvers).
​6. Character 6 (MMA): Well-rounded hybrid fighter featuring ground take-downs, leg kicks, clinch attacks, and striking combinations.
​7. Character 7 (Wrestling): Grappler focus, heavy slam attacks, power takedowns, suplex moves, and armor-plated burst attacks.
​8. Character 8 (Taekwondo): Long-range specialist, fast spin kicks, jump kicks, and high-reaching multi-hit kick combos.
​9. Character 9 (Judo): Defense and counter-grapple focus, utilizing momentum throws, hip tosses, joint locks, and sweep takedowns.
​10. Character 10 (Capoeira): Rhythm-based movement (Ginga), sweeping low kicks, inverted cartwheel strikes, and unpredictable acrobatic moves.
​Game Mechanics @COMMENT_BODY@ Controls:
​Controls: 8-way directional movement (Jump, Crouch, Advance, Retreat/Block), Light Attack, Heavy Attack, Special Technique, and Throw/Grapple button.
​Audio: Impactful hit sound effects, martial-arts vocal cues/kiai, distinct stage background music, and match announcements (\"Round 1\", \"Fight!\", \"KO!\"). (2D Game, Desktop)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
